FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Condition'
  AND lower(concept_name) LIKE '%nutri%deficien%'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept = 'S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name
LIMIT 50

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept, domain_id, concept_class_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Condition'
  AND (
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nutritional deficien%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nutrition deficien%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%vitamin%deficien%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%mineral%deficien%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%iron deficien%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%folate deficien%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%cobalamin deficien%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%malnutrition%'
  )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept = 'S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 20
  c.concept_name AS diagnosis,
  co.condition_concept_id AS concept_id,
  COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patients
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = co.person_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE DATEDIFF(year, p.birth_datetime, co.condition_start_date) >= 65
  AND co.condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 435227  -- Nutritional deficiency disorder
  )
GROUP BY c.concept_name, co.condition_concept_id
ORDER BY diagnosis_occurrences DESC, patients DESC, diagnosis
